☆ 比賽場地位於機場的非管制區，不需要機票即可自由前往的區域。但若是搭乘飛機抵達桃園機場，則需完成入境手續後才能夠抵達會場！
☆ The competition venue is located in the non-restricted area of the airport, which can be accessed without the need for an airplane ticket. However, if you arrive at Taoyuan Airport by plane, you must complete the immigration procedures before you can reach the venue.
